verdict.rationale: Tipping prompts on a reader or terminal are a fair question for a card-payments and POS product like SumUp, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions tipping, tip percentages, smart amounts, or custom tips. The pack covers only Cloud API, reader SDKs, refunds, offline transactions and pricing.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal
